pitch.headline: Pedagogy first. AI training for teachers
pitch.body:
Most AI training is too technical or outdated. AITutoro teaches by doing: designing lessons, creating assessment criteria, explaining difficult topics. Five-minute sessions and skills you can use in the classroom tomorrow. AI takes over the routine — more time for students.

In a nutshell:
- 5 minutes a day instead of long videos
- Practice instead of theory
- AI tailored to school, not the office

pitch2.headline: From AI awareness to proficiency
pitch2.body:
Long seminars don't work — teachers are overloaded. AITutoro offers 5-minute sessions that fit between lessons. Each module has a specific outcome: ready-made assessment criteria, a simple explanation of a difficult topic, or quick feedback for a student. We adjust the pace to you and how comfortable you feel in the digital world.

The result: staff will see AI as a real help and time saver, not an additional burden. A concrete change in everyday work, not just theory.
